name: SnapTeX
description: Fast, local-first LaTeX editing and structural preview for VS Code and the browser.

paragraphs: Fast, local-first LaTeX editing and structural preview for VS Code and the browser.

What's new in 0.8.2: Open PDFs in the Web preview and navigate between PDF and source with offline SyncTeX. Web editing now auto-saves after a quiet delay while preserving cursor position and undo history; server projects also support Ctrl+B compilation. This release adds more Web themes and fixes table rules and project-relative graphics paths in both preview backends.

SnapTeX renders prose, math, references, citations, figures, PDFs, tables, algorithms, theorem-like environments, and TikZ without requiring a local TeX distribution. It is designed for responsive writing and navigation; use a full TeX toolchain for final pagination and publication output.
features: Elastic paged preview with flexible page-bottom space, alongside optional continuous mode.
KaTeX math, PDF.js figures, and bundled TikZJax rendering.
Block hashes, incremental patches, and dependency-aware refreshes.
Default virtual mode for lower DOM and heavy-resource memory use on long documents.
Bidirectional navigation, automatic scroll sync, references, and contextual tooltips.
